svg.title: Use Case: Import a CRL (Session-Scoped or Persistent)

g.text: Use Case: Import a CRL (Session-Scoped or Persistent)
Held only by this client's CertEntry. Never written
to storage, never visible to another client or to
store CRL, invalidate CRL cache entry
The trust store refreshes from the slot's current snapshot and holds
the same shared CRL object as the slot manager. Concurrent imports are
therefore ordered by slot state, not by notification arrival.
